description.value: A Subway franchise located on Willingdon Avenue in Burnaby, offering made-to-order subs, wraps, and salads with customizable fresh toppings and fresh-baked bread. Orders can be placed in-store, via app, through delivery, or at curbside pickup. As an independently owned and operated franchise, it provides a widely recognizable and accessible meal stop along a busy urban corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (30 spaces) at 89m. Total: 30 spaces.
